info.name: FBLabs SD Mapper V2 with the m6 kernel ROM
info.description: The SD Mapper V2 cartridge with the m6 kernel ROM (build/m6-sdmapper.rom or build/m6-sdmapper-legacy.rom, copied into the ROM pool by the harness; no checksum, the ROM changes with every build) and one card, the image given with -hda, an SDHC card; the second slot is empty.
